policy: Prefer complete current Blooms fields with matching source identity; contextual prose faithfully follows the actual source. Keep unverified plant and modifier names Chinese. Runtime display fixes never rename internal objects or parser delimiters.

info.origin: Context Aware AI using actual 4.1 source and verified Blooms terms; specialized names retained
info.english:
Sprays fumes at groups of zombies and summons Squash helpers to crush nearby targets.

Damage: <color=#8B0000>40/1.5s</color>
Special: <color=#8B0000>When attacking, extends two Squash, each dealing 20 times its Attack Damage. After 2s, they crush the leftmost zombie on the lawn, prioritizing the same lane. This effect then requires a 10s wait before it can be used again.</color>
Fusion Recipe: <color=#8B0000>Fume-shroom + Squash</color>

introduce.origin: Context Aware AI using actual 4.1 source and verified Blooms terms; specialized names retained
introduce.english: Although often reported for settling disputes physically, 窝瓜大喷菇 insists it has never laid a hand on anyone. It explains that it only sprays a few harmless spores. As for the Squash frequently seen leaping from behind it to crush others, it says those are merely hallucinations caused by inhaling the spores.

info.origin: Context Aware AI using actual 4.1 source and verified Blooms terms; specialized names retained
info.english:
Attracts nearby projectiles, adds its own damage, then sends them crashing down on zombies.

Usage Condition: <color=#8B0000>Odyssey Mode</color>
Fusion Recipe: <color=#8B0000>Squash-nut + Mag-nut</color>
Toughness: <color=#8B0000>4000</color>
Damage: <color=#8B0000>1800 (Crush)</color>
Targeting Range: <color=#8B0000>5 x 5</color>
Special:
<color=#8B0000>1. Attracts horizontally fired projectiles within 1.5 tiles, increases their damage by [its own damage], and absorbs them. Projectile traits are not retained, and zombies are not attacked during this phase.
2. After absorbing 10 projectiles, distributes them evenly among zombies within range. Each projectile deals crush damage in a small area. During this attack, it does not block zombies.</color>
Odyssey Modifier 1: <color=#8B0000>窝爱砸: Targeting range becomes an entire lane.</color>
Odyssey Modifier 2: <color=#8B0000>窝爱吸: Attacks only after absorbing 30 projectiles.</color>

introduce.origin: Context Aware AI using actual 4.1 source and verified Blooms terms; specialized names retained
introduce.english: 磁能窝瓜坚果 has a severe need for order. Even in battle, it cannot resist pulling projectiles onto its magnetic field lines and arranging them neatly. Zombies often complain that nothing looks more chaotic than it does. Then they get to see something even more chaotic: an enraged 磁能窝瓜坚果.
